name: Regular-Adaptive Octree Construction
aliases: Octree Construction with Complex Cell Criteria
definition: An algorithm to build an octree that is regular until a specified minimal level (minLevel) and adaptive between minLevel and a maximal subdivision level (maxLevel).
summary: Regular-Adaptive Octree Construction is an iterative top-down algorithm that builds a Sparse Voxel Octree with a fixed regular structure at shallow depths and adaptive resolution based on surface topology and curvature.
